Welcome to 'World of Animals,' our channel is devoted to the heartfelt mission of rescuing, feeding, and rehoming street cats and abandoned kittens in our local community. Each video is a testament to the transformative power of love and care, showcasing the incredible journeys of our feline friends—from their days on the streets to finding safe, loving homes. By joining us, you become a crucial part of this mission, helping us extend our reach and make a lasting difference in the lives of these deserving animals. 
Together, we can create a future where no cat goes hungry and every kitten finds the warmth and affection they deserve. Subscribe to 'My Paws' and take part in this life-changing journey! 🐱💖 #CatResue #KittenAdoption #StreetCatFeeding
